title: Flour Power
excerpt: So many flours with different powers.
content:
All purpose flour, whole wheat flour, millet flour. So many flours with different powers. But are they all used for? Let explore together.

The usual suspects

All purpose flour

We all know it. Most of us it love it (a little too much). And some of course hate it. All purpose flour has made quite the impact on our lives. It has made baked goods soft, chewy, delicious, and addicting. But let's look into how all purpose flour is made.
